notes.title: 3rd Person Update
notes.notes:
Once player dies they can tab between any surviving agents and control them via 3rd person view.
Activatae this function by selecting the "E" key
Weapon sounds also upgraded.
Other bug fixes as well

notes.notes:

notes.title: Fox4Elite Update Alpha V0.09
notes.notes:
Game can now be played offline (massive coding project)
Hair rigs completed to improve performance, prevent hair slip bugs and have more natural movement
Death animation bug resulting in frozen animation and forward face plant fixed.
Abandoned Factory Map - numerous bug fixes to building sizes and collisions.

notes.title: Fox4Elite has just been released on Steam
notes.notes:
[b]Post Release Roadmap Alpha Version 0.08[/b]
1. Activate Map 3 "Police Station"
2. Apply Cover animations for all NPCs
3. Replace Majica Cloth hair with rigged hair for better results and FPS
4. Retune all death animations
5. Implement enemy NPC Taunting system
6. Finish code to enable game to be played offline.
7. Tweaks to Enemy AI
8. Collision tweaks to Abandoned Factory Map
9. Tweaks to Agents looks and implementation of Camo outfits.
10. Player 3rd Person control of each live Agent through Tab Camera key.
